description: Reads the company's own website and drafts the empty positioning fields: value propositions, differentiators, and exclusions. Filled fields stay as they are. Read the result later with get_company_profile. Admin only. Counts toward a daily cap per workspace. Send an idempotency_key. A retry with the same idempotency_key returns the first answer and does not act again. It starts no second job and uses no allowance or daily cap a second time.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string you make for this request, such as a UUID. Send the same key when you retry, and Debriefing returns the first answer instead of acting twice.

name: draft_positioning

replayed.description: True when this answer repeats an earlier call with the same idempotency_key.

title: Draft positioning
